name: 幻想西天加强版
group_note: Journey-to-the-West-themed ES-lineage mudlib (MudOS v22pre11 MudLib Build 3310), in-game titled 西行战记, with a live GB/BIG5 dual-encoding menu at connect time. Bugs fixed: (1) classic §6.6 convertd.lpc Greek-table stray-backslash bug, 45 occurrences, crashing the banner cat() on every connection; (2) classic §8.1 check_legal_name() byte-doubled length bounds + i%2==0 gate + tail-slice bug in logind.lpc (is_chinese() itself was already correctly codepoint-based); (3) live GB/BIG5 encoding-menu bug (§8.7) -- BIG5 selection produced 'Invalid GB code' spam on every subsequent line, fixed by mapping both menu choices to the GB passthrough encoding. Admin (fluffos/Mud@2026) seeded via real registration + adm/etc/wizlist, confirmed via visible 目前权限：(admin) display. Full registration->look->score->quit flow verified twice (before and after the LPC formatter pass) with a real Chinese name (秦风). Formatter run found 2 files (d/moon/obj/poem.lpc, u/bmw/task/taskd.lpc) with pre-existing broken/corrupted string literals predating this pass (an unterminated poem string and a literal pager-output artifact baked into the source) -- reverted the formatter's respacing on both rather than compounding pre-existing corruption; left otherwise unfixed as out of scope for a WASM verification pass.
